Conditions signalled by zuroar

Source: R/conditions.R
zuroar-conditions.Rd

Every error zuroar signals inherits from zuroar_error, so code can catch them all with tryCatch(..., zuroar_error = ). A more specific class says what went wrong:

Details

  • zuroar_error_value: a value outside the domain, such as NA, a negative or fractional number, or one above 2^32 - 1; or an output type that cannot hold a value, such as as.integer() on a bitmap holding a value above .Machine$integer.max.

  • zuroar_error_index: a position outside seq_len(length(x)), or NA, in x[i].

  • zuroar_error_unsupported: an operation a set does not define, such as x > 5, or one that would need the values as a plain vector, such as x[1] <- 5 or identical(x, y).

  • zuroar_error_format: bytes that are not a valid portable Roaring bitmap, for example a corrupt .rds file.

  • zuroar_error_memory: CRoaring could not allocate memory.

Match on the class, not on the message, which may change.

Examples

tryCatch(roar(-1), zuroar_error_value = function(e) "out of domain")
#> [1] "out of domain"
